rule.description: A method hosted on a workspace data owner whose body makes no member access to its own host's data, while making concentrated data access (at least 5 accesses over at least 3 distinct members) into the data of one foreign workspace data owner.

checks.description: Detect methods declared on a workspace data owner whose bodies read data exclusively from one foreign workspace data owner.
checks.detected_relation: emitter or selection method -> concentrated data access on one foreign workspace data owner (>= 5 data accesses over >= 3 distinct members, 0 accesses on the host's own data)
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: A method whose entire data dependency lies in another owner belongs with that owner; a host that contributes no state to the method forces every data operation in the method to reach across the module boundary, so the behavior is misplaced.
